zh: XSL：扩展稀疏线性化的代数攻击。
过定义方程组：方程数多于未知数的系统。
线性化：把高次单项式当作新变量。
S 盒：分组密码的非线性替换层。
代数攻击：用方程组求解密钥的攻击。
en: XSL: an algebraic attack using extended sparse linearization.
Overdefined system: a system with more equations than unknowns.
Linearization: treating high-degree monomials as new variables.
S-box: the nonlinear substitution layer of a block cipher.
Algebraic attack: solving key variables through equation systems.
